builder.componentIdHint: Used to reference this component in bindings, e.g. its selected row.
builder.noRunnables: No runnables on this page yet.
builder.runnablesHint: A runnable connects this page to a workflow: run it with inputs from the page, or read results of its past runs.

deletePage.title: Delete page
deletePage.description: Delete "{name}" and its components? Navigation actions pointing to it are removed too.

errors.namePattern: Start with a letter; use only letters, digits and _
errors.duplicateId: Another component on this page already uses this ID
errors.duplicateRunnable: Another runnable on this page already uses this name

state.hint: Initial values of the app state, as JSON. Read them in bindings as state.name; change them with a Set state action.

runnable.description: Connect this page to a workflow.
runnable.name: Name
runnable.inputsHint: Values passed to the workflow. Use text, JSON, or a binding to page values.
runnable.noPublicVariables: This workflow has no public or protected variables to set.
runnable.outputsHint: Workflow variables returned to the page as runnables.NAME.outputs. Secret and private variables can’t be returned.

stale.outputsHint: Untick variables the workflow no longer returns, then save.
stale.secret: now secret, so it’s never returned

runnable.persistHint: Turn off for read-only lookups so they don’t fill the workflow’s history.
runnable.onPausedHint: Runs instead of On success when the workflow stops at an approval step. The run continues once someone approves or rejects it.

form.name: Name
form.optionsHint: One per line: value, or value {'|'} label. Or a binding to a list returned by a workflow.
form.passwordHint: Mark the workflow variable this fills as secret — otherwise a run that keeps history stores the password with it.
form.duplicateField: Another field already uses this name
form.fromDataHint: Bind to a list of fields a workflow returns, e.g. {'{'}= runnables.type.outputs.fields ={'}'}. Each one is written like a field here (name, label, type, default…); ones that aren’t valid are left out.
form.generateDescription: Create this form’s fields from a workflow’s inputs and run it on submit.
form.generateHint: Replaces the form’s fields, adds a runnable that sends every field to the workflow, and runs it on Submit.
form.skippedVariables: Private variables and ones a form can’t set are not listed.

binding.title: This field can show live values
binding.template: inserts a value into the text
binding.raw: uses the value itself (a number, a list…) — must be the whole field
binding.references: You can refer to state.NAME, runnables.NAME.outputs.VAR, runnables.NAME.data, a component’s .value, .values or .selectedRow, and page.params.NAME.

builder.noComponents: No components on this page yet.
builder.copyDroppedActions: Removed {count} action(s) that pointed to runnables or components not on this page.
builder.previewNotice: Preview — actions run your real workflows. The app was saved before starting.

codes.bindingUnclosed: “{snippet}” isn’t closed — add {closer}. It shows as empty until fixed.
codes.bindingRawNotAlone: “{snippet}”: a raw reference {raw} must be the whole value — inside text, use {template}.
codes.bindingRawPath: “{snippet}”: a raw reference {raw} can only hold a path, like state.value.
codes.bindingInvalid: “{snippet}”: invalid template ({detail}). It shows as empty until fixed.
codes.inputPrivate: Runnable “{runnable}” sets “{variable}”, which is private in the workflow.
codes.inputOutput: Runnable “{runnable}” sets “{variable}”, which is an output of the workflow.
codes.outputPrivate: Runnable “{runnable}” reads “{variable}”, which is private in the workflow.
codes.outputSecret: Runnable “{runnable}” reads “{variable}”, which is secret and is never returned.
codes.historyVariableUnknown: Runnable “{runnable}” reads variable “{variable}”, which the workflow doesn’t have.
codes.runnableUnused: Runnable “{runnable}” is never run (not on page load, and no action runs it).
codes.stateUnknown: “{ref}” uses a state value nothing sets.
codes.runnableUnknown: “{ref}” uses a runnable that isn’t on this page.
codes.outputNotRequested: “{ref}” reads “{variable}”, which runnable “{runnable}” doesn’t return — add it to its outputs.
codes.componentUnknown: “{ref}” refers to a component that isn’t on this page.
codes.consoleRunnableUnknown: Run Console shows “{runnable}”, which isn’t a runnable on this page.

fill.label: Fill to bottom
fill.hint: When nothing sits below it, it grows to the bottom of the page, container or tab.

tabs.hint: Drop components into the open tab on the canvas. A tab’s id (right) is what activeTab and defaultTab use. Display “steps” turns the tabs into a wizard: Back / Next, and Finish on the last step.

listView.refused: “{type}” can’t go inside list view “{list}”: every item would share its value. Use text, buttons, KPIs, alerts, details, charts and containers.

from.data: From the items written in Data.
from.preview: Seen in Preview; bindings in the template can use them.
from.history: From the workflow’s latest saved run.

listView.noFields: Not known yet. Open Preview once: the fields of the items it shows will be suggested here and when you type item. in the template.

expand.title: Expand editor (⌘⇧E)
expand.description: Edit the field in a larger editor; it is saved when you close it.

builder.stepOverHint: Run this step to its end (a whole sub-workflow, loop or branch), then pause again
builder.stepOutHint: Run the rest of this sub-workflow, then pause in the workflow that called it
builder.inProjectsHint: In {names}. Saving changes it in every one of them.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted workflows and apps stay here for 30 days. Restoring one brings back its project, tags, versions and schedules (turned off), with the same identifier, so apps that use it work again. Runs aren't kept.

deleteAlert.title: Delete forever?
deleteAlert.description: "{name}" will be deleted for good, with its versions and schedules. This can't be undone.

emptyAlert.title: Empty the Trash?
emptyAlert.description: The item in the Trash will be deleted for good. This can't be undone. | The {n} items in the Trash will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.

projectMap.connectHint: Drag from a node's dot to another node to connect them

from.status: One lane per status. Lanes follow each node's status, so they can't be dragged between.
from.kind: One lane per kind: workflows, helpers, apps, globals, schedules.

hint.custom: No custom lanes yet. Add them in the left sidebar, or group by owner.
hint.owner: Nobody owns anything yet. Pick a node and set its owner: each owner gets a lane.

details.adoptHint: It isn't in this project. Adding it here gives it a status on this map; it stays in the projects it's in.
details.adoptFailed: Couldn't add it to the project
details.missingGlobal: Workflows use this global, but it doesn't exist. Create it in Variables.
details.linkMissing: This was linked to something that no longer exists.
details.name: Name
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe it in a sentence or two. The Assistant drafts from this.
details.removeLineFromPlan: Remove from plan (the real connection stays)
details.noLinesPlan: No lines yet. Drag from the dot on its right edge to another node.
details.dynamic: {count} workflow builds global names while it runs, so its globals aren't on the map. | {count} workflows build global names while they run, so their globals aren't on the map.
details.dynamicSelf: This workflow builds a global name while it runs, so some of its globals can't be shown.
details.createGlobalHint: Creates the global {name} in Variables and links this node to it.
details.globalNameInvalid: Rename it first: a global's name uses letters, digits and _ only, and starts with a letter or digit.
details.scheduleNeedsLine: Connect this schedule to the workflow it should start (drag from its dot to the workflow), then create it here.
details.scheduleTargetPlanned: {name} is still planned. Build it first, then create the schedule.
details.removeFromProjectFailed: Couldn't take it out of the project
details.hidden: A workflow you don't have access to. Ask its owner, or an admin, to share it, or for a copy of your own.

overview.title: Overview
overview.hint: Solid nodes exist; dashed ones are ideas, and so are lines drawn by hand. Once something is built, its lines come from its definition. Click a node to see what depends on it.

differences.heading: Plan check
differences.hint: Compares what you planned (lines, inputs and outputs) with the real workflows, apps and schedules. Ideas aren't checked until they're built.
differences.empty: What's built matches what you planned.

wrongKind.writes: The plan says {from} writes {to}, but it only reads it.
wrongKind.reads: The plan says {from} reads {to}, but it writes it.

differences.linkMissing: {name} was linked to something that was deleted.
differences.inputs: {name} was planned with the inputs {planned}. The workflow has {actual}.
differences.outputs: {name} was planned with the outputs {planned}. The workflow has {actual}.

missing.calls: The plan says {from} runs {to} as a sub-workflow, but it doesn't.
missing.runs: The plan says {from} runs {to}, but nothing in the app is wired to it.
missing.writes: The plan says {from} writes {to}, but none of its steps do.
missing.reads: The plan says {from} reads {to}, but it doesn't use it.
missing.triggers: The plan says {from} starts {to}, but it starts something else.

unplanned.calls: {from} runs {to} as a sub-workflow, which isn't on the plan.
unplanned.runs: {from} runs {to}, which isn't on the plan.
unplanned.writes: {from} writes {to}, which isn't on the plan.
unplanned.reads: {from} reads {to}, which isn't on the plan.
unplanned.triggers: {from} starts {to}, which isn't on the plan.

legend.title: Lines
legend.globalsRead: Reads a global (open arrow, still pointing at the global)
legend.amber: Amber: the plan says one thing, the definition another
legend.unplanned: Orange: exists, but isn't on the plan
legend.external: {count} node from outside this project is shown faded. | {count} nodes from outside this project are shown faded.
legend.direction: Each line goes from what does something to what it does it to: an app runs a workflow, a workflow runs a sub-workflow.
legend.readHint: To show that something reads a global, drag from the global to it.

assistant.offer: Here's what the map says this workflow should do. Check it, then draft it.
assistant.linkFailed: The draft was saved, but couldn't be linked to the map

projectMap.resetLayoutHint: Forget where nodes were dragged and arrange them again

empty.title: Nothing on the map yet
empty.description: Add workflows and apps to this project, or start planning: add the workflows and apps an idea needs, then connect them.

all.title: All projects
all.description: Every project in its own box. Things more than one project uses sit in a box of their own.
all.hint: Plan on a project's own map. Open one to add planned nodes.

projectMap.created: {name} was created and linked to the map

statusWhy.planned: Only on the map so far. Build it, create it or link it to something real.
statusWhy.missingGlobal: Workflows use this global, but it hasn't been created yet.
statusWhy.draft: An Assistant draft nobody has marked ready yet. Check it in the builder.
statusWhy.neverRun: Exists, but has never run successfully. Run it once to get to Tested.
statusWhy.changedSinceRun: Changed since its last successful run. Run it again to get back to Tested.
statusWhy.ranSinceChange: Ran successfully after its last change.
statusWhy.appUntested: Some of the workflows it runs aren't tested yet.
statusWhy.appTested: Every workflow it runs is tested.
statusWhy.exists: Exists. A global can be marked ready once you've checked its value.
statusWhy.scheduleOff: Switched off: it won't start anything.
statusWhy.scheduleUntested: On, but the workflow it starts isn't tested yet.
statusWhy.scheduleTested: On, and the workflow it starts is tested.
statusWhy.signedOff: Tested and signed off as ready.
statusWhy.hidden: You don't have access to this workflow.

ready.stale: Was marked ready, but it changed (or stopped passing) since. Check it again.

editor.title: Map
editor.addHint: Click to add beside what's selected, or drag onto the map.
editor.lanesHint: Top to bottom. Drag a node into a lane, or pick its lane in its details.

notes.label: Note
notes.nodePlaceholder: For the team: decisions, open questions, links…

ideas.label: Show ideas
ideas.hint: Off: only what exists. Ideas and planned lines hide; notes stay.

schedule.oneWorkflow: A schedule starts one workflow, so {name} got a new planned schedule of its own.
schedule.tooMany: This schedule is drawn to {count} workflows, but a schedule starts only one. Give each workflow its own schedule first.

unlinkSchedule.title: Unlink and delete "{name}"?
unlinkSchedule.description: The schedule would keep starting its workflow otherwise, so unlinking deletes it. This can't be undone. The card stays as an idea.

unlinked.removedDescription: The link brought it in, so unlinking took it out. It's kept, and stays in any other projects it's in.
unlinked.kept: "{name}" stays in this project: it was here before you linked it.
unlinked.globalUsed: "{name}" stays on the map: the project's workflows use it.

removeFromProject.title: Take "{name}" out of this project?
removeFromProject.description: It leaves this map. The workflow itself is kept, and stays in any other projects it's in.
removeFromProject.descriptionCard: Its card leaves the map too. The workflow itself is kept, and stays in any other projects it's in.
